description: Set custom field values of one record. Required: entity, entity_id, values { key: value } — null or "" clears. Values are checked against the field type (number, date YYYY-MM-DD or DD.MM.YYYY, yes/no, allowed options). Required fields cannot be cleared.

entity.description: Area of the record: contacts, accounts, agreements, leads or a module table (mod_…)

values.description: Field values as { key: value }; null or empty string clears a field

name: set_custom_values
